# mimecast_google_workspace_directory_integration (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Google Workspace directory integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "google_service_account_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "mimecast_google_workspace_directory_integration" "example" {
  description                    = "tf-example-google-workspace"
  domains                        = ["example.com"]
  user                           = "directory-admin@example.com"
  service_account_key_wo         = var.google_service_account_key
  service_account_key_wo_version = 1
  acknowledge_disabled_accounts  = true
  enabled                        = true
  max_unlink                     = "100"
  delete_users                   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Integration description.
- `user` (String) Google Workspace user email address used by the service account.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `acknowledge_disabled_accounts` (Boolean) Whether disabled directory accounts are acknowledged.
- `delete_users` (Boolean) Whether users removed from the directory are deleted from Mimecast.
- `domains` (List of String) Domains synchronised by the integration.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is enabled.
- `info` (String) Additional integration information.
- `max_unlink` (String) Maximum number of users that one synchronisation may unlink.
- `service_account_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Google service-account JSON key. Write-only; increment service_account_key_wo_version when changing it.
- `service_account_key_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for service_account_key_wo. Increment this when changing the key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mimecast Google Workspace directory integration ID.
- `last_sync_date_time` (String) Time of the last directory synchronisation.
- `status` (String) Integration status.
- `sync_running` (Boolean) Whether a directory synchronisation is running.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_google_workspace_directory_integration.example integration-id
```
